summary: Ubuntu 9.10 (Karmic Koala) was released on 29 October 2009. Features: Ubuntu One cloud sync (later discontinued), Software Center replacing Add/Remove, GRUB 2 as default bootloader, Ubuntu Enterprise Cloud based on Eucalyptus, ARM port for netbooks. Ubuntu Server focused on cloud deployment. First Ubuntu release with a software store.
notes: Unsupported since 2011-04-30. Kernel 2.6.31. Ubuntu One was Canonical's early cloud storage bet; later shut down in favor of third-party options.
